data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2014 the syndicate had gross claims outstanding of GBP 822.7m. During 2014 there was a reassessment of prior years' claims reserves which produced a net release of GBP 85.8m (the report provides this as a net figure). The managing agent attributes this release to a number of classes (notably marine/upstream energy, war/political risk, commercial property, downstream energy and treaty reinsurance). No aggregate gross prior-year movement (insurance liabilities column) is disclosed in the notes, so a gross PYD figure could not be reliably derived from the available tables.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: War, Political Violence and Political Risk

data.data_quality_notes: The report provides an explicit net prior-year release of GBP 85.8m (note labelled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding') but does not disclose the corresponding GROSS (insurance liabilities) movement required by the extraction rules. No gross claims development triangle is present in the published notes to allow calculation of a gross PYD. Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. Lob movement figures taken from the prior-year movement note are net releases by class; these have been copied and presented (with release sign convention) but are net amounts (not gross) - confidence for those is reduced accordingly.
